name: mathematica-web-ports
description: Browser ports of twenty-six Wolfram Demonstrations (robot motion planning, rotations, Euler angles, probabilistic roadmaps, car paths, p-norm unit balls, art gallery, robot singularities, two-link kinematics, robot motion with obstacles, breadth-first search planning, distance norms, Dubins car paths and isochrons, RRT and RRT*, camera and lasers, Minkowski sums, four-bar linkage, Denavit-Hartenberg parameters, torus chart, manipulability ellipsoid, arm configurations, manipulator workspaces, PRM in 3D). Static site: all computation runs in the browser.
author: Tico Hannan
